subject: Ciências
description_pt: Comparar as ideias evolucionistas de Lamarck e Darwin apresentadas em textos científicos e históricos, identificando semelhanças e diferenças entre essas ideias e sua importância para explicar a diversidade biológica.

components.description_pt: Descrever as ideias evolutivas de Lamarck e Darwin conforme apresentadas em textos científicos e históricos
components.description_en: Describe Lamarck's and Darwin's evolutionary ideas as presented in scientific and historical texts
components.cc_component_description: Summarize scientific and technical ideas obtained from grade-appropriate complex texts or media

components.description_pt: Comparar similaridades e diferenças entre as explicações de Lamarck e Darwin para mudança biológica
components.description_en: Compare similarities and differences between Lamarck's and Darwin's explanations of biological change
components.cc_component_description: Compare two arguments on the same topic to identify similarities and differences in the evidence each emphasizes

components.description_pt: Avaliar a significância das ideias lamarckianas e darwinianas em explicar a diversidade biológica
components.description_en: Evaluate the significance of Lamarckian and Darwinian ideas in explaining biological diversity

cc_matches.description: Compare and critique two arguments on the same topic and analyze whether they emphasize similar or different evidence and/or interpretations of facts.
Read and comprehend grade-appropriate complex texts and/or other reliable media to summarize and obtain scientific and technical ideas and describe how they are supported by evidence.
